lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Supervised application: knowing local rules before applying

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic knowing local rules before applying task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: The learner takes the working-age rules recorded earlier this year, checks them again against a second, current source to confirm nothing has changed, and researches one additional first-job rule for their location, recording both with sources.
safetyNotes: Rules are re-checked against a current source rather than assumed to be unchanged from earlier research.
materials: learner-local: working-age rule notes from earlier this year

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: Did re-checking change anything, and either way, what does that tell you about how often information like this should be reverified?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Genuine re-verification: Uses a genuinely different, current source. | Additional rule research: Records a real, specific additional rule with a source. | Reasoning about reverification frequency: Draws a plausible general conclusion from the re-check result. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner research how these rules would differ for a job in a genuinely different location (such as a different state or country) and compare the two rule sets.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic knowing local rules before applying task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: working-age rule notes from earlier this year
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

localMaterials.label: a notebook or document
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: knowing local rules before applying worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner takes the working-age rules recorded earlier this year, checks them again against a second, current source to confirm nothing has changed, and researches one additional first-job rule for their location, recording both with sources.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact knowing local rules before applying decision or action.
Model move 2: Before re-checking, restate the working-age rules you recorded earlier this year.
Model move 3: Re-verify those rules against a second, current source, and note whether anything changed.

Model check: Genuine re-verification: Uses a genuinely different, current source. | Additional rule research: Records a real, specific additional rule with a source. | Reasoning about reverification frequency: Draws a plausible general conclusion from the re-check result.

resources.title: knowing local rules before applying action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for knowing local rules before applying.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: knowing local rules before applying coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner takes the working-age rules recorded earlier this year, checks them again against a second, current source to confirm nothing has changed, and researches one additional first-job rule for their location, recording both with sources.
Coach direction: Before re-checking, restate the working-age rules you recorded earlier this year.
Learner prompt: Restate what you previously found about working-age rules for your location.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: knowing local rules before applying complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Re-verify those rules against a second, current source, and note whether anything changed.
Response 1 (t2-p1): Record what your second source says and whether it matches your earlier finding.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I used a genuinely different source than my original research earlier this year.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: knowing local rules before applying minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Did re-checking change anything, and either way, what does that tell you about how often information like this should be reverified?

Success checks: Genuine re-verification: Uses a genuinely different, current source. | Additional rule research: Records a real, specific additional rule with a source. | Reasoning about reverification frequency: Draws a plausible general conclusion from the re-check result.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: knowing local rules before applying supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional knowing local rules before applying condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Genuine re-verification: Uses a genuinely different, current source. | Additional rule research: Records a real, specific additional rule with a source. | Reasoning about reverification frequency: Draws a plausible general conclusion from the re-check result..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guidedFirstAttempt.setup: The learner takes the working-age rules recorded earlier this year, checks them again against a second, current source to confirm nothing has changed, and researches one additional first-job rule for their location, recording both with sources.
guidedFirstAttempt.prompt: Restate what you previously found about working-age rules for your location.
coachMoves: Ask the learner to name the condition.
Point to one model step only.
Give feedback against one observable success check.
guidedFirstAttempt.successCondition: Genuine re-verification: Uses a genuinely different, current source.

simulationRoute.title: knowing local rules before applying — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the knowing local rules before applying task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

Reasoning about reverification frequency: Draws a plausible general conclusion from the re-check result.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Genuine re-verification: Uses a genuinely different, current source. | Additional rule research: Records a real, specific additional rule with a source. | Reasoning about reverification frequency: Draws a plausible general conclusion from the re-check result.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g10-u06-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
